title: The Book of Enoch
author: R. H. Charles (trans)
description: The Book of Enoch (1 Enoch), translated from the Ethiopic by R. H. Charles (Oxford: Clarendon Press, 1912 revised edition, also issued in a popular SPCK edition in 1917), with introduction and notes. Preserved complete only in Ge'ez and canonical in the Ethiopian Orthodox Church, this Jewish apocalyptic compilation dates from the third century BCE to the first century CE. Its five parts are: the Book of the Watchers, telling of the fallen angels who mated with women and taught forbidden arts and Enoch's journeys through heaven and the underworld; the Similitudes or Parables, with the mysterious Son of Man; the Astronomical Book on the calendar and heavenly luminaries; the Dream Visions, including the Animal Apocalypse; and the Epistle of Enoch with the Apocalypse of Weeks. Quoted in the Epistle of Jude, it shaped early Christian angelology and eschatology. Charles's translation is the classic English version.
